artists.source_line: Welcome to the KIZZ ESSENCE ALL IN ONE BEDBURG 2027!🎉

features.rationale: The event's location is the main hotel, Landhaus Danielshof, where guests can also book rooms, so the parties take place in the hotel where dancers are invited to stay.
The description recommends a further hotel, Hotel Gut Hohenholz, and the room booking is separate from the pass.
A DRESSCODE heading with Friday, Saturday and Sunday entries is given, so a dress code is stated.
